name: mirage
text: You caught a real bug. The card shows RED 'every key refused' for BoltOdds, but the engine's own key check (2 min before my answer) said accepted. The cause is in the light logic: the usage ledger's 'refused' mark (likely left by BoltOdds' socket refusing a connection, or an old call) was ranked above a fresh passing key check, so a stale refusal beat the live test. My answer was right about the key; the app was wrong. I've changed it so a fresh accepted check (engine or your phone's test) outranks a ledger refusal: it will show yellow with both facts. Running its test now; it ships in the next release with the other pending fixes. The 'depleted' reading is wrong, the key is fine.
